fix_contract.hypothesis: Bounded query expansion over already-sanitized Latin tokens may recover inflectional variants (e.g. delivered↔delivery) on the existing simple FTS index without changing ranking or schema.
fix_contract.expected_improvement: Lexical-variation misses recover the decisive span; total correctness, decisive recall, and unanswerable precision do not drop.
security_invariants: user tokens never inject tsquery operators
prefix :* atoms originate only from the expander
fix_contract.performance_budget: FTS statement timeout remains 200ms; mean fts_latency_ms must stay below that timeout and must not exceed 2× the same-harness control mean.
required_tests: Gate M gold extractive benchmark (isolated FTS)
Gate P BEN_EXISTING_FTS regression vs committed baseline
fix_contract.rollback_strategy: Leave BEN_FTS_LEXICAL_EXPAND unset/off. Do not merge. Do not deploy. Production retrieval path is unchanged while the flag is off.

capabilities.principle: existing-capabilities-first; no new dependency if current infra suffices

items.name: postgres_simple_fts_prefix_operator
items.reason: Existing generated text_tsv uses to_tsvector('simple', text) plus GIN. to_tsquery('simple', 'stem:*') already matches inflectional variants on that index. No schema change, no new extension.

items.name: query_prep_sanitize_and_or_join
items.reason: build_or_tsquery already sanitizes user tokens and OR-joins them. I1 adapts it to append expander-generated stem:* atoms when BEN_FTS_LEXICAL_EXPAND=prefix. Default remains off.

items.name: english_text_search_config
items.reason: Switching the generated column to 'english' is a schema change (forbidden). Snowball delivered≠delivery stemming is also not guaranteed for this pair, and Hebrew tokens would be mishandled.

items.name: embeddings_hybrid_rerank_vector_db
items.reason: I1 forbids embeddings, hybrid retrieval, rerankers, and new vector infrastructure. Lexical prefix matching is in-stack.

items.name: new_python_dependency
items.reason: Current Postgres FTS already provides a sufficient mechanism.

items.name: provider_native_pdf
items.reason: Out of scope; Gate P already measured this as blocked without keys.

items.name: learn_new_stemmer
items.reason: If prefix atoms over-expand or under-stem a future class, record the pair for a later gated morphology table. Do not add one in I1.

capabilities.chosen_mechanism: Fail-closed query-prep prefix atoms (stem:*) against existing to_tsvector('simple') GIN. Default BEN_FTS_LEXICAL_EXPAND=off.

candidates.change_summary: Append expander-generated stem:* atoms to the existing simple OR tsquery. One FTS round-trip. Same org/workspace/file filters.
